information_state.reason_calibration_not_invalidated: No Stage C run existed. All triggering screens are permanently labeled paper_evidence=false.

changes.before: Provider-native structured message blocks were projected into the string-only DAG and could be reconstructed from that lossy projection after any rewrite.
changes.after: Losslessly unrepresentable message histories carry an opaque marker. Structural rules abstain by default; only rules declaring no message inspection or mutation may propose, and provider adapters retain native objects for dispatch.

changes.before: Only anthropic.resources.messages stable resources were wrapped; OSWorld V2 calls client.beta.messages.create.
changes.after: Stable and beta Anthropic sync/async create/stream resources are discovered, independently wrapped, alias-deduplicated, and restored to their exact prior descriptors.

changes.before: Every OutputBudget mutation emitted max_tokens and could leave a conflicting max_completion_tokens field.
changes.after: A rewrite preserves the caller's existing cap family, otherwise selects max_completion_tokens for gpt-5/o1/o3/o4 and max_tokens for other chat models, and removes the alternate field.

changes.before: A magnitude-scaled heuristic labeled p95/p99 could overshoot the observed maximum and could also underreact to a late high output.
changes.after: Fresh-profile p95 is a bounded asymmetric moving proxy and p99 is the all-history observed maximum. The latter is a conservative upper bound on the intended 50-sample nearest-rank p99.
changes.reason: The configured 50-sample window still does not age persisted observations; another numbered revision is required after that implementation.

changes.before: bd-voua blocked OSWorld request-shape admission; bd-zsvv, bd-lhte, bd-pbus, and bd-bwgu had not yet been discovered at the initial freeze.
changes.after: bd-voua, bd-zsvv, bd-lhte, and bd-pbus are resolved at Stage E0 only. bd-bwgu is an explicit Stage C blocker. No workload is admitted by these closures.

outcome_blindness_assertion: Every revision-2 change was triggered by source inspection, deterministic unit/integration tests, or synthetic no-network Stage E0 traces. No calibration, pilot, or confirmatory task outcome informed the change.
